R,C=20,19
g=[[5]*C for _ in range(R)]
for c in range(9,18): g[0][c]=6
for c in range(9): g[19][c]=6
points=[(4,14),(7,17),(9,16),(14,13),(17,12)]
active=sorted({c-9 for r,c in points})
for k in active:
    # matching lower boundary beam
    for r in range(19): g[r][k]=9
    c=9+k
    rs=[r for r,pc in points if pc==c]
    if rs:
        end=max(rs)
        for r in range(1,end): g[r][c]=9
        g[end][c]=4
    else:
        for r in range(1,20): g[r][c]=9
print(active)
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in g))
